title: Punjab farmers’ coordinated two-hour rail roko on Lakhimpur Kheri anniversary
location: Multiple railway sites in Punjab: Amritsar/Manawala, Hoshiarpur/Mandiala, Jalandhar/Bhangala, Tanda, Dasuya, Ludhiana/Sahnewal and Phillaur are named in the report.
organizer: Samyukta Kisan Morcha (non-political), Kisan Mazdoor Morcha and local farmer unions
threshold_50_evidence: Rail traffic disruption confirms action at several sites but no count per location or clear qualitative crowd size is reported; total trains affected is not attendance.

occurrence.summary: The Tribune/PTI reports farmers squatted on tracks for a two-hour protest beginning 12:30 pm.

date.summary: Article date and body identify Thursday, Oct 3, 2024.

location.summary: Named rail sites across Punjab; not all locations individually enumerated.

organizer.summary: SKM (non-political) and KMM organized the action; local unions held named sit-ins.

demands.summary: MSP, loan waiver, Swaminathan recommendations, sugarcane arrears and justice in Lakhimpur Kheri incident; direct state-policy target for farm policy.

participants.summary: No headcount captured. Train delays/diversions are not used as a proxy.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Unknown at every specified gathering; cannot add multiple locations or infer from trains affected.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific evidence of protester violence; unknown.

state_response.summary: Transport effects and official train diversions are reported; arrest, force, accommodation and other coded responses are not established.

start_date.summary: The source identifies the event as Oct 3 and begins time at 12:30pm.

end_date.summary: Two-hour action; exact end clock not independently reported beyond duration.

scope.summary: Coordinated action at multiple Punjab sites; whether one statewide event or linked local protests remains reviewable.

state_target.summary: Demands addressed state policy and justice in the Lakhimpur Kheri case.

episode_continuity.summary: A separate anniversary rail action; the connected long-running Shambhu/Khanauri campaign is noted in source but no merger inferred.

notes: Candidate remains pending threshold; not a claim that the action failed to meet threshold.
open_questions: Can a contemporary report establish at least 50 people at one named rail-site gathering, without aggregating across sites?
Was the statewide action one nationally organized event or linked local actions under the codebook?
Are any immediate state responses beyond railway diversions documented?

title: Punjab farmers’ road and rail blockades over delayed paddy procurement
location: Punjab; reported sites include Jagraon/Nanaksar, Sherpur Chowk, Ladowal, Kohara, Dehlon and 17 rail-block locations named in search-only Tribune result.
scope: statewide/coordinated but exact event grouping unresolved
organizer: Samyukt Kisan Morcha; Bharti Kisan Union (Ekta Ugrahan); farmer, commission-agent and labor unions
threshold_50_evidence: TOI body confirms a three-hour road blockade at Jagraon and other local spots but gives no participant counts. Search-only leads describe state-wide action, not simultaneous attendance.

occurrence.summary: TOI body says farmers, commission agents and laborers held three-hour blockade at Nanaksar in Jagraon; other named spots also reported.

date.summary: TOI article published Oct 14 states the protest ran noon to 3pm on Sunday Oct 13.

location.summary: Jagraon and additional locations; 17 sites are only in Tribune search result and its body retrieval failed.

organizer.summary: TOI identifies Samyukt Kissan Union and participating farmer/labor unions; Tribune search result mentions SKM and BKU actions.

demands.summary: Protesters accused Punjab government of failure to procure paddy; state policy/action explicitly targeted.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No count by location. Terms “blockade” and traffic disruption do not establish 50 participants.

state_response.summary: Chief Minister planned to meet Union minister the following day per related search result; no immediate coded response established for this gathering.

start_date.summary: Body explicitly gives start noon on Oct 13.

end_date.summary: Body explicitly gives end at about 3pm.

scope.summary: Several local blockades described; statewide organization and exact national/local episode boundary unresolved.

state_target.summary: Protest directly criticized state government procurement failures.

episode_continuity.summary: October 13 is distinct from Oct 3 MSP/Lakhimpur anniversary action; same unions may participate, but issue and date differ.

notes: An article about announcements on Oct 12 was not used as proof; only Oct 13 actual-action body supports occurrence.
open_questions: Can a permitted contemporary source give simultaneous attendance at Jagraon or another named site?
Can the 17-site search-only Tribune article body be retrieved through a different already-known URL? Do not retry that exact URL; any new target needs its own assessment.
Should local actions be split or treated as one organized state-wide event?
